criteria: Semantic HTML with a title, viewport, main and navigation
All local anchor links resolve to IDs
Filter visibly hides nonmatching event cards and restores all
No external dependencies, fetch, localStorage or network requests
At least two typed context records for this approach
run.intent: Build a concise polished Juniper Community Garden static website: story, three plots, volunteer sessions, visit information, and a real local event filter. Two alternative approaches from the same starter. Use relative public assets, no network dependencies or storage; opaque sandbox origin forbids localStorage. Keep implementation small: HTML/CSS/JS in separate files, each under 150 lines; write in chunks under 2000 tokens to fit the model request ceiling. Filtering must visibly hide nonmatching cards, including when card CSS uses display:flex/grid (use [hidden]{display:none!important} or explicit display). RSVP may change an in-memory confirmation only. First read the supplied browser finding. Before finishing, publish one requirement and one alternative via context_publish and link them to this run intent. Implement and run the approved checks, then call execution_complete.

argv: const fs=require('node:fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('public/index.html','utf8');for(const r of [/<!doctype html>/i,/<html[^>]+lang=/i,/<title>[^<]+<\/title>/i,/<meta[^>]*viewport/i,/<main[\s>]/i,/<nav[\s>]/i])if(!r.test(s))throw Error('Missing semantic HTML: '+r);

argv: const s=require('node:fs').readFileSync('public/index.html','utf8');const ids=new Set([...s.matchAll(/id=[\"']([^\"']+)[\"']/g)].map(m=>m[1]));for(const m of s.matchAll(/href=[\"']#([^\"']+)[\"']/g))if(!ids.has(m[1]))throw Error('Broken anchor '+m[1]);
